text: If you obey him, you will be protected and rescued from danger.
You are wise to love God's Law, but if you are not sincere, you will be tossed around like a boat in a storm.
Be sensible and trust what God has said in his Law.
If you want others to listen, then think about what you know and how to say it best.
Fools talk in circles like a wheel going around.
To make fun of a friend is to act like a horse that snorts at anyone who tries to ride.
Each day of the year depends on the sun for light, so why are some days more important than others?
The Lord used his wisdom and made them different. Some have a special meaning, others are festivals,
and some are sacred days— but most are ordinary.
We humans were made from the soil,
and the Lord used great wisdom to make each of us different, with different destinies.
He blessed our ancestors and made them great, and he even let some be his holy priests. But he put a curse on the nations of Canaan— they were defeated and forced to leave the land.
Humans become what the Creator chooses, just as clay is shaped by the hands of the potter.
There are many opposites— good and evil, life and death, sinners and God's people.
You can see that God Most High made everything the opposite of something else.
I am the last in the line of the teachers of wisdom, like a poor man picking grapes after the main harvest.[73]
But the Lord blessed me, and I gathered enough grapes to fill a wine-pit.
I wasn't working just for my own good, but to help all those who want to learn wisdom.
So pay attention to what I say, all you officials and leaders.

Never give anyone else power to make decisions for you— not your husband or wife,[74] and not your children, relatives, or friends. And don't give away property— if you later want it returned, you will have to beg for it.
As long as you are alive, don't let others run your life.
It is better that your children ask you for money than for you to ask them.
Be the best at whatever you do, and do only what brings honor and not shame.
Wait until you are about to die before giving your children their inheritance.
If you feed your donkeys and beat them with a stick, they will carry their loads. Slaves are like that— feed and discipline them, and they will do their work.
If you don't want trouble, keep your slaves busy; otherwise, they will have time to think about becoming free.
Use collars and leather straps to keep slaves at their work, and punish the rebellious ones by torturing them. *
Keep your slaves busy or they will have time to think
of ways to cause trouble.
Slaves are supposed to work, so give them something to do, and if they refuse to obey, put them in chains. But always be fair, not arrogant.
If one slave is all you have, treat him like a family member or even as you treat yourself. You worked a long time to buy that slave, and you need his help to survive.
If you are mean, and that slave runs away,
where will you look for him?
